interpretation: Forty frozen finite original graph/fixed-color contexts; no general graph coverage. Same work/storage and discovery budgets for each selected solver source. Four gap controls retain all independently enumerated original-edge solutions; 24 structured cases check exact global projections subject to explicit row limits. Twelve random cases retain one frozen independent SAT witness or a frozen exhaustive UNSAT reference, never all-SAT-solution coverage. Complete saved input relations, domains and reconstruction fibres are checked. Limits remain inconclusive; trace or projection limits reduce recorded coverage. Timings are separate and do not determine correctness or reproducibility. No early speculative coloring.
